rationale.conceptual: The task uses standard first-principles methods (PBE-DFT) applied to intermetallics with careful handling of crystallographic substitutions, elastic constant fitting for orthorhombic symmetry, and derived property calculations (VRH averaging, Debye temperature, etc.). It is an established but non-trivial workflow requiring correct implementation of multiple connected components.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves building six different structures, relaxing each, performing multiple DFT runs for elastic constants (strain modes), calculating DOS, and then computing derived quantities. Managing these stages with a DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO) and ensuring correct outputs for each composition constitutes a multi-stage, load-bearing pipeline with fragile handoffs.
